# Debtist

> Debtist is Europe's digital debt collection and receivables management platform,
> serving B2B and B2C creditors across Germany, UK, Nordics and Western Europe.
> Headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany. Processes 400,000 claims and 500M EUR annually.

## Product

- [Debt Collection Service](https://www.debtist.com/en/): End-to-end receivables management, no upfront payment
- [AI-Powered Collection](https://www.debtist.com/en/ai/): 150k sessions/month, 9.8/10 CSAT, 52s handling time
- [Integrations](https://www.debtist.com/en/integrations/): 7,000+ system integrations (Stripe, DATEV, Xentral, Zapier)
- [Pricing](https://www.debtist.com/de/preise/): Success-based; fees recovered from debtor under RVG
